summary: 32 publish, 25 publish_flagged, 3 reject across 29 orgs and 31 relationships. All 25 sources were independently re-fetched and all 160 evidence items checked against saved raw bodies. Systemic issues: several organization records infer headquarters from datelines, contact/mailing addresses, or office listings; QBI records prove selection rather than signed contracts; two UK awards name local legal entities without evidence mapping them to canonical parents; one business combination was misclassified as an acquisition. Rejected: rel:honeywell-cambridge-quantum-combination, rel:uk-testbed-quera, rel:uk-testbed-rigetti. Honeywell's 2021 majority stake does not establish post-IPO ownership, and because build.mjs fills missing scalar fields from later files, trapped_ion.json can still publish co:quantinuum.parent as co:honeywell. Because neutral_atom.json sorts before this topic, its Berkeley headquarters for Atom Computing, Palaiseau headquarters for Pasqal, and Garching street headquarters for planqc remain the build winners despite conflicts or lower-precision values in this file; counsel did not alter those other topics.
